name: Idea → RFC
intent: Turn an unshaped idea into a decision a team can act on, including the decision not to build it.

steps.name: Classify the idea and find its prior art
Gather the evidence the decision needs
Name the constraints this idea has to live inside
Produce at least two alternatives and say what each costs
Human decision, then the ADR that records it
steps.note: Direction is the human architect's. The agent writes the record, not the decision.

escalations.when: the idea changes a protected value or a source-of-truth boundary
no alternative survives the challenge step
escalations.note: That is a finding, not a failure.

completion: an RFC exists with at least two alternatives and their costs
the adversarial findings are attached, resolved or explicitly accepted
either an ADR records the decision, or the bead records why it was deferred
memory: constraints discovered that were not written down before
evaluation: did the eventual implementation match the RFC, and if not, what did the RFC fail to anticipate
